description: This Java class 'ModelDataFileReader' reads and parses XML configuration files defining data file models, including records and fields, for the OFBiz framework. It manages caching of readers, loads data file definitions, and provides access to these models.

classes.name: ModelDataFileReader
classes.description: A final class responsible for reading and parsing XML data file model definitions, managing cache, and providing access to data file models.

methods.name: getModelDataFileReader
methods.description: Returns a cached or new instance of ModelDataFileReader for a given URL.

methods.name: createModelDataFile
methods.description: Creates a ModelDataFile object from an XML element.

methods.name: createModelDataFiles
methods.description: Reads the XML document and creates a map of data file names to ModelDataFile objects.

methods.name: createModelField
methods.description: Creates a ModelField object from an XML element.

methods.name: createModelRecord
methods.description: Creates a ModelRecord object from an XML element.
